note: Fail-closed per-gate cardinality contracts for priv/ggen/ash-pplan-workflow-pack.
Keyed by GATE STEM (gates/NNN_stem.rq -> "stem"), not filename.
Every contract is PREDICATE-anchored: the anchor's own blind spot (total loss of the
anchor predicate) is exactly what the companion verify/*.unbound.rq queries name, so
contract + companion have disjoint blind spots.
VALUES contracts are used wherever the gate emits one row per repeatable edge
(hasTask, dependsOn, outcome, supportsProperty, emitsEvidence, realization, subtask).
A VALUES contract counts (subject, value) pairs over the whole graph, which equals the
gate's row count as long as each edge's endpoints carry the join keys the gate requires
(taskId/capabilityId/workflowName) -- and if they do not, the unbound companions catch
"provider_props" and "provider_evidence" keep VALUES contracts anchored on their edge
predicates: total loss of the predicate drives the gate to zero rows (:gate_failed), and
a dangling Provider lacking ap:providerId is named by verify/040/050 companions.

ERRC R2 (2026-10-04): task_props moved to DERIVED_ROWS (ggen_igniter branch errc-igniter-envelope-and-chain-fixes). The gate emits one row per DERIVED (task, property) pair joined through providers, which no single (subject, value) anchor can express: VALUES on ap:supportsProperty counts (provider, property) edge pairs (14) while the gate emits (task, property) rows (18), and 15 tasks make ROWS-on-a-subject equality unreachable. DERIVED_ROWS expresses the expected count as a QUERY -- gate rows must equal the contract query's row count over the same graph, fail-closed (a contract query that does not execute refuses the gate; a missing/ambiguous query is a load-time contract refusal). The blind spot is now the derivation itself: a deletion that moves the gate query and the contract query identically is invisible to the contract, and is exactly what verify/100_task_props.unbound.rq names.

ERRC R2 RESOLVED (2026-10-04): the previously-recorded KNOWN STANDING refusal (14 edge pairs vs 18 derived rows, no mode expressing a derived count) is closed by upstream DERIVED_ROWS; task_props now passes at 18 == 18.

task_props.query: PREFIX ap: <https://w3id.org/ash-pplan#> SELECT DISTINCT ?workflow ?task ?property WHERE { ?w a ap:Workflow ; ap:workflowName ?workflow ; ap:hasTask ?t . ?t ap:taskId ?task ; ap:requiresCapability ?c . ?p a ap:Provider ; ap:supportsCapability ?c ; ap:supportsProperty ?property . }
